page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sn1.7xlarge is a compute-optimized instance built on the KVM hypervisor. It features 32 dedicated physical cores powered by an Intel Xeon 8163 processor operating at 2.5 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. The hardware configuration includes 64.0 GB of system memory, providing a ratio of 2.0 GB per core. This instance does not include local storage or GPU accelerators, relying entirely on network-attached storage and baseline network bandwidth of 6 Gbps.

Benchmark data indicates a clear distinction between single-core and multi-core capabilities. Single-core performance is weak, as shown by stress-ng and Geekbench single-core tests falling into the bottom 25%, and single-threaded gzip compression scoring in the bottom 10%. However, the 32 dedicated cores deliver average multi-core performance in stress-ng, PassMark, and Geekbench multi-core tests. Memory bandwidth is average for both cached and uncached reads, though the overall PassMark memory score is weak.

The instance offers qualitative cost efficiency for workloads that scale horizontally across many cores without requiring high memory density or local storage. Tradeoffs include the lack of bundled local storage and lower single-threaded efficiency. It is suitable for multi-threaded processing tasks, static web serving, software compilation, and moderate database operations.
